part.text: Now I understand the architecture: a generic plugin pipeline (`SSGEngine`) with `onFile`/`beforeBuild`/`afterBuild` hooks, `buildSite()` in `site.ts`, and a CLI in `cli.ts`. I'll add a manifest-backed page cache at the engine level so the plugin interface itself stays untouched. Let me set up a task list and start implementing.
